page.title: Brutalist video template for product launches, free
page.description: A brutalist launch video: huge capitals, raw borders, orange accents and hard cuts. Describe your product and edit everything. Free, in your browser.
page.blurb: Thick black borders, giant capitals, paper grain and a hazard-orange accent. Nothing floats; everything slams. It suits indie products with a point of view and launches that should feel like a poster on a wall.
